_comment: Offline patch file for scripts/gnstatic.py patch.
Each entry needs: image (executable name or a dylib under Frameworks),
either vmaddr (absolute, e.g. 0x1002331b60) or offset (relative to the
__TEXT base, e.g. 0x2331b60 - the number the runtime anchor log prints as
'(static 0x...)'), expect (bytes that must already be there), bytes (what
20008052c0035fd6 is 'mov w0, #1 ; ret'. The expect check is what keeps a
stale offset from writing into the middle of a 260 MB binary.
